subject: MAP + evaluation window -> final exit gate & onboarding boarding timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightpath.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@brightpath.com, alice.choi@brightpath.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP and proposed evaluation window for BrightPath pilot

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, procurement would like a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, required evidence (SOC2, data handling), and the preferred signature/PO timing. Our preliminary constraints: security review needs two full business weeks, and our procurement team needs a signed SOW + PO to allocate budget for Q4 start.

Proposed evaluation window: Nov 29 - Dec 3 (3 business days for function + 2 days for final assessment). Can Redwood commit to an on-prem-like private deployment for the pilot and have a single point of contact for incidents?

Attached: initial_rfi.xlsx (procurement checklist).

Best,
Sarah
Procurement Manager
BrightPath Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightpath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and proposed evaluation window for BrightPath pilot

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear constraints. I attached a draft MAP (MAP_BrightPath_v1.xlsx) and a redlined SOW (SOW_BrightPath_draft.pdf) that encode the milestones we talked about:

- Week 0 (prep): account provisioning, IP allowlist, and test dataset upload.
- Eval days: 2026-11-29 through 2026-12-03 (functional/cost/latency checks).
- Security evidence delivery: SOC2 report + vendor security checklist by 2026-11-24 to allow your team two weeks of review.
- Final go/no-go decision target: by close of business 2026-12-02.
- Target signature window: DocuSign routing starting 2026-12-02 with aim to have signatures by 2026-12-07.
- Expected start date (production on-boarding): 2026-12-08 (first full business day after signatures).

Quick asks: 1) Can Procurement confirm the internal approver list and PO lead? 2) Does Security need any additional artifacts beyond the vendor checklist I attached?

Internal note for Marissa / Olga / Sean: please review the MAP and SOW for legal/finance redlines. If we lock the security evidence delivery this week I can compress the signature runway to the first week of December.

Attachments: MAP_BrightPath_v1.xlsx; SOW_BrightPath_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Re: Initial MAP and proposed evaluation window for BrightPath pilot

Mina —

Looks good to me. Olga: can Legal review the SOW redlines below (commercial terms + liability)? Sean: confirm the onboarding runbook and whether we can do a two-step start (canary -> full). If security signs off on the checklist by Nov 24, finance can push PO by Dec 1.

Marissa
Account Executive

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightpath.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.com, alice.choi@brightpath.com, legal@brightpath.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 19:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation window -> final exit gate & onboarding boarding timeline

Mina —

Quick update from our side after internal sync: Security is asking for a filled vendor checklist (I attached Vendor_Security_Checklist.xlsx) and a short architecture diagram showing where PHI will be processed and how logs are retained. We can commit to the evaluation window of Nov 29 - Dec 3 but will need at least one business day after the evaluation to route the final security approval to procurement.

Good news: Procurement is comfortable with the SOW draft pending one contractual wording change on data retention. Expect that the PO will be ready for signature around Dec 2–3, but we will likely need the DocuSign envelope to be live on Dec 2 to meet that cadence.

Can Redwood confirm: 1) we will provide the SOC2 snapshot and the architecture diagram by Mon Nov 23? 2) DocuSign routing order (Contact order: Sarah -> Procurement -> Legal)?

Thanks —
Sarah

Attachment: Vendor_Security_Checklist.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightpath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation window -> final exit gate & onboarding boarding timeline

Sarah —

Confirmed and thanks for the clarity. Quick summary of agreed next steps and final gate orchestration:

1) Redwood will upload SOC2 snapshot and a two-page architecture diagram to your secure folder by EOD Nov 23.
2) We will populate the vendor checklist and return it by Nov 23 as well.
3) Evaluation remains Nov 29 - Dec 3 (we will run a canary test on Nov 29 morning and a follow-up load window Nov 30).
4) DocuSign envelope: we will create and pre-seed routing order as Sarah -> procurement@brightpath.com -> legal@brightpath.com. Estimated envelope creation: 2026-12-02 09:00 PST.
5) Target signature completion: by 2026-12-07 to allow Redwood a 1-business-day ramp for canary scheduling (canary on Dec 08, full ramp Dec 15).

Attachments being uploaded for your team now: MAP_BrightPath_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW_BrightPath_draft.pdf (final redlines applied), PO_template.pdf.

Olga — please confirm the final contractual phrasing we discussed on retention and I will fold it into the DocuSign copy. Sean — please prepare a one-page canary runbook (ops contact + rollback thresholds).

If everything above looks good, consider this thread the working MAP for signatures. I will also create the DocuSign envelope on Dec 2 and drop the HubSpot timeline link into this thread.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
